title.narrative: IOM - Generating Renewable & Innovative Designs for Displacement, GRID 2

description.narrative: Generating Renewable and Innovative Designs for Displacement (GRID) 2. The overall objective is to replicate and scale the renewable energy model piloted in the first phase: srengthening disaster preparedness and response capacities in at-risk communities. The project ensures that evacuation centres caused by extreme weather events, are equipped with renewable energy systems that provide reliable power during both normal times and emergencies.
